characters.summary: Master Tigress is a formidable martial artist specializing in Tiger Style kung fu, relying on immense physical strength, lightning-fast reflexes, and unyielding discipline. She engages opponents in close-quarters combat using devastating strikes, palm thrusts, and acrobatic maneuvers.
weaknesses: vulnerable to psychological manipulation regarding her emotional detachment or search for approval
over-reliance on direct physical force against versatile mystical or fluid martial arts
limitations: lacks ranged projectile attacks
strictly relies on physical conditioning and martial training

sources.supports: martial arts skills, Iron Shirt technique, and physical attributes

feats.claim: Smashed through thick stone and wood barriers using the Iron Shirt technique.
Lifted a heavy metal portcullis single-handedly to let others escape.

notableResults.note: Overwhelmed by Tai Lung's nerve strike technique after a fierce duel.
Defeated multiple armed wolves in hand-to-hand combat.

unknowns: Exact limits of her durability against heavy explosive force remain untested.

characters.continuity: The Lion King (Animated Film and Series)
characters.summary: Timon is a suricate who relies on quick wit, distraction, and teamwork with Pumbaa rather than direct combat prowess. He avoids physical confrontation whenever possible, preferring to trick enemies, create diversions, or utilize environment hazards.

mechanisms: using Pumbaa as a human shield

weaknesses: extremely physically weak
cowardly when faced with genuine danger
limitations: zero offensive combat capabilities against large opponents
depends entirely on stealth, trickery, or allies

sources.supports: character background, personality traits, and behavioral habits

feats.claim: Successfully distracted hyenas using a hula dance and a luau costume.
Dug complex tunnel networks rapidly to escape predators.
feats.citation: The Lion King II: Simba's Pride

notableResults.note: Fled in terror when confronted by Shenzi, Banzai, and Ed.

unknowns: Combat viability outside of comedic distraction scenarios.

characters.summary: Tom is a domestic cat possessing cartoonish resilience, infinite persistence, and access to a wide array of household traps and weapons. Despite enduring catastrophic blunt force trauma, explosions, and electrocution, he continually regenerates to pursue Jerry.
weaknesses: easily distracted by female cats or temporary comfort
overconfident schemes frequently backfire on himself
limitations: intellect is frequently undermined by emotional outbursts and frustration
prone to injuring himself with his own poorly constructed traps

sources.supports: cartoon abilities, durability, and standard equipment usage

feats.claim: Reformed his body instantly after being compressed into a flat sheet by a steamroller.
Survived multiple point-blank explosions without permanent injury.

notableResults.note: Nearly every attempt to capture Jerry results in Tom being outsmarted or injured.

campaignTags.claim: Uses various complex household traps, firearms, and improvised devices to catch Jerry.

unknowns: Exact upper limit of physical damage required to permanently incapacitate his toon physiology.

characters.summary: Toph Beifong is a blind master earthbender who perceives the world through seismic sense, detecting vibrations through the ground. She fights with direct, unyielding stances, utilizing metalbending and earth manipulation to overwhelm opponents with heavy projectiles and structural manipulation.
weaknesses: blindness makes her completely deaf to attacks originating from ungrounded sources like air or water
unable to perceive vibrations on slippery ice or soft sand without difficulty
limitations: requires solid ground contact to perceive opponents via seismic sense
ineffective when suspended in mid-air

sources.supports: earthbending, metalbending, seismic sense, and combat techniques

feats.claim: Discovered and executed the first-ever metalbending technique to escape a steel cage.
Held up the falling walls of a massive underground library using earthbending alone.
feats.citation: Avatar: The Last Airbender, Season 2, 'The Library'

notableResults.note: Defeated fellow earthbenders using superior tactical positioning and metalbending.

campaignTags.claim: Invented the discipline of metalbending entirely on her own while trapped in a metal box.

unknowns: Full potential of her metalbending proficiency in modern industrialized settings.

characters.summary: Tweety is a small yellow canary who appears innocent and helpless but consistently outsmarts Sylvester the Cat through clever traps, lucky environmental hazards, and unexpected ferocity when cornered.
weaknesses: extremely fragile physical body if caught outside of cartoon safety
limited offensive output against non-feline threats
limitations: relies heavily on Sylvester falling into his own traps or miscalculating
lacks heavy destructive power

sources.supports: character abilities, relationship with Sylvester, and cartoon traits

feats.claim: Triggered numerous elaborate traps that dropped anvils and safes onto Sylvester.

notableResults.note: Consistently evades capture and inflicts severe slapstick damage on Sylvester.

campaignTags.claim: Possesses functional avian wings allowing sustained flight.

unknowns: Performance against non-cartoon predators with area-of-effect attacks.

characters.summary: Uncle Iroh is a legendary Grand Master of the White Lotus and a master firebender renowned for his wisdom and raw power. He utilizes advanced firebending techniques, including lightning redirection, breath control, and explosive concussive blasts.
weaknesses: reluctant to fight unless protecting loved ones
vulnerable to physical exhaustion if drawn into prolonged grueling combat
mobility: acrobatic leaps enhanced by fire propulsion
limitations: cannot generate his own lightning, only redirect it
prefers peaceful resolution over combat

sources.supports: firebending mastery, lightning redirection, and physical combat feats

feats.claim: Broke out of a maximum-security ice-and-stone prison cell using concentrated superheated breath.
Successfully intercepted and redirected lightning generated by Azula.
feats.citation: Avatar: The Last Airbender, Season 2, 'The Crossroads of Destiny'

notableResults.note: Easily defeated multiple armed guards during his escape from Ba Sing Se.

campaignTags.claim: Generates and manipulates intense streams of fire and explosive fireballs.

unknowns: Full extent of his power output when pushed to absolute lethal intent.

characters.summary: Ursula is a powerful sea witch who combines dark aquatic magic, deceptive contract manipulation, and massive cephalopod tentacles in combat. She uses magical potions, energy blasts, and illusion spells to control her environment and defeat rivals.
weaknesses: relies heavily on the magical nautilus shell containing her voice for supreme power
overconfident in her contractual supremacy and magical dominance
limitations: destruction of her nautilus shell strips her of her voice-based magical amplification
vulnerable to physical impalement when giant-sized

sources.supports: magical abilities, sea witch traits, and transformation feats

feats.claim: Transformed Ariel into a human and various merfolk into wretched polyp souls using magic.
Absorbed King Triton's trident and grew to colossal skyscraper proportions, controlling the ocean weather.

notableResults.note: Tricked Triton into signing away his crown and magical trident.
Impaled by the splintered bowsprit of a wrecked ship steered by Eric.

campaignTags.claim: Casts complex transformation spells and energy projections using dark magic.
Naturally breathes underwater as an octopus-hybrid sea entity.
Resides and fights naturally within aquatic environments.

unknowns: Limits of her magic outside of aquatic or coastal environments.

characters.summary: Velma Dinkley relies on exceptional intellect, deductive reasoning, and technological troubleshooting rather than physical combat. She solves mysteries by analyzing clues and setting elaborate mechanical traps for culprits.
weaknesses: severe myopia; helpless without her glasses
zero physical combat capabilities against aggressive monsters
limitations: cannot fight opponents physically
frequently drops or loses her glasses at critical moments

sources.supports: intellect, reliance on glasses, and problem-solving skills

feats.claim: Successfully unmasked dozens of disguised criminals by deducing minute physical and chemical clues.

notableResults.note: Trapped the suspect using an elaborate pulley and net system.

campaignTags.claim: Constructs complex Rube Goldberg-style traps to capture suspects.

unknowns: Combat viability when separated from her analytical tools.

characters.summary: Violet Parr is a superhero capable of generating invisible force fields and turning completely invisible. She uses her powers for stealth, protection, and creating concussive force field bubbles to incapacitate foes.
weaknesses: lacking in self-confidence during high-stress combat initially
vulnerable if caught off-guard before her shields can be activated
limitations: sustaining large force fields under heavy sustained assault drains her stamina
invisibility does not mask her sound or weight

sources.supports: invisibility, force field generation, and superhero abilities

feats.claim: Created a massive spherical force field that withstood heavy automated turret fire and explosive impacts.
Infiltrated Syndrome's secret island base undetected using her invisibility.

notableResults.note: Trapped armed guards inside force fields to neutralize them.

campaignTags.claim: Can render her entire physical body completely invisible at will.

unknowns: Exact maximum weight capacity her force fields can deflect before fracturing.

characters.summary: WALL-E is a compact waste allocation robot equipped with a heavy-duty compactor torso, treads, and a laser tool. While designed for cleaning trash, he demonstrates incredible survival instincts, resourcefulness, and improvised problem-solving.

mechanisms: ability to retract head and limbs into his body cube

weaknesses: fragile optical lenses and solar battery dependency if cut off from light
lacks aggressive combat programming
limitations: slow movement speed on standard treads
not built for combat against armed humanoid adversaries

sources.supports: robot capabilities, solar recharge, laser tool, and compact design

feats.claim: Compressed entire cars and massive piles of trash into neat square cubes.
Used his onboard ship-repair laser to cut through heavy metal bulkheads.

notableResults.note: Overrode the rogue autopilot's steering mechanism to save the Axiom.

campaignTags.claim: Is a fully sentient autonomous waste-management robot.
Equipped with a built-in industrial laser tool and crushing compactor.

unknowns: Durability of his tread system against high-explosive ordnance.
